news.title: 13 岁铁拳选手长得酷似年轻时的三岛一也 (Kazuya Mishima) 在 Stacked 锦标赛中击败格斗游戏职业选手
news.summary: A 13-year-old Tekken player went viral over the weekend for beating a seasoned pro in a competitive tournament

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/tekken-player-goes-viral-kazuya-mishima-1794857622423.jpg
A 13-year-old Tekken player went viral over the weekend for beating a seasoned pro in a competitive tournament — all while boasting a hairstyle that looked just like Kazuya Mishima’s.

Thaiger Uppercut (TGU) is a major fighting game tournament that takes place in Thailand each fall. It’s known for drawing some of the best talent across multiple titles from around the world, with established players flocking to the competition for fame, glory, and of course, prize money.

This year, however, an unexpected combatant emerged: 13-year-old Martinski, a Tekken player from the Philippines, left audiences stunned after taking out Pinya, a well-known Japanese Tekken pro who has been competing at a top level since the days of Tekken 7 .
HUGE round in pools. 📺 https://t.co/10vkbWvgVE // #TEKKEN8 #TGU2026 https://t.co/TlC3imwNAD

Martinski beat Pinya 2-0 in a stunning show of strength, knocking his opponent to the losers’ bracket. However, it wasn’t just the absurd talent he displayed at such a young age that made him go viral within the fighting game community; he also styled his hair to look like Kazuya Mishima, the Tekken series’ former protagonist-turned-antagonist.

In fact, Martinski made it to the Top 48 — a solid feat for a player of any caliber, but an especially impressive achievement for one so young. Looking at Start.gg, the 13-year-old competitor finished in 25th place out of 187 other players,
Over on X/Twitter, Martinski spoke about his results, saying he was “proud of this run and grateful for the experience” and that “there's always something to take away from every tournament.”
@ELITE_Martinski IS INSANE AT TEKKEN 8 AND ONLY 13 YEARS OLD. CONGRATULATIONS FOR MAKING IT INTO TOP 48 AT TGU 🇹🇭 https://t.co/D9x1PTxUKN
Martinski also competed in a 3v3 teams bracket under the name ‘Martinski’s Magic Light Team.’ The group finished 9th out of 24 total teams.

Martinski’s performance at TGU highlights a growing trend within the fighting game community; young players are becoming increasingly successful in tournaments, particularly where Tekken 8 and Street Fighter 6 are concerned.

For example, 16-year-old Neia stunned audiences after making it to the Top 24 for Tekken 8 at Evo France, one of the most stacked tournaments of the season. She even beat established pros Hakim ‘Skywalker’ Touré and Jonathan ‘Tibetano’ Medina to get there, and has been a rising star in the scene ever since then.

And in Street Fighter 6, 17-year-old Chilean player Blaz recently helped his team win the Street Fighter League Americas Finals — but he’s been knocking heads since he was just 15, and even got second place at Capcom Cup 11 a few months after his 16th birthday. Another young Chilean talent, Craime, made the Top 8 at Evo Las Vegas this year at 15 years old, but has been competing in tournaments since he was 13. He famously won the Esports World Cup for Street Fighter 6 earlier this year, cementing his status as a major threat for the competition.

I got the chance to interview Blaz after his monumental victory with team 2Game after the SFL Americas Finals last weekend, where he explained why modern games like Street Fighter 6 attract younger players and why LATAM is such a strong region right now.

news.title: 侠盗猎车手 6 黑客承认所有指控
news.summary: Arion Kurtaj released dozens of GTA 6 videos to the public more than a year before the game was formally revea

content.v: The BBC reports that Arion Kurtaj, who hacked Rockstar and dumped a massive trove of content from Grand Theft Auto 6 more than a year before it was formally revealed, has pleaded guilty to that and other hacks carried out while he was a member of the Lapsus$ hacking group.

Kurtaj's hack of Rockstar was notable not for the GTA 6 infodump that followed, but because of how it was carried out: With an Amazon Fire Stick , a mobile phone, and a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, connected to a TV in a Travelodge hotel room where he was being held under police protection because of threats against him made by rival hackers over stolen bitcoin.

A 2023 assessment found Kurtaj had "acute autism" and was determined to return to "cybercrime" as soon as possible, despite the fact that he was literally standing trial for doing cybercrimes. Because of that, the jury was asked to determine if he had committed the hacks (it found he had) but not whether he had done so with criminal intent; he was subsequently sentenced to an indefinite stay at a secure hospital , where he would remain unless and until doctors determined that he was no longer a danger.

As we noted at the time, "danger" might seem a bit of a strong word for someone who leaked videogame footage, but the Lapsus$ group had also hacked Microsoft , Samsung , Nvidia and UK telecom company BT&EE, and stole millions in cryptocurrency from individuals. Kurtaj was also reportedly violent while in hospital custody, causing "dozens" of reports of injuries or property damage. In July 2026, that 'no longer a danger' determination was presumably made, as Kurtaj was released from hospital and moved to prison to await retrial.

He has now pleaded guilty to multiple hacks carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old, including the Rockstar hack that led to the GTA 6 leak. He also pleaded guilty to assaults on workers while in custody, which the BBC report says included "multiple biting incidents."

As I said when Kurtaj was moved from hospital to prison, the whole thing strikes me as odd. The big question is how Kurtaj's state of mind at the time of the crimes will influence the outcome of his guilty plea, given that a previous court determined that he needed multiple years of institutionalization. BBC tech reporter Joe Tidy, who's been following the case since Kurtaj's transfer, also described it as "an unusual move" in his report.

Coincidentially, one must assume, Grand Theft Auto 6 launches for consoles on November 19. Kurtaj will be sentenced at a future date. The leaker who goes by Cyberleek , who recently distributed several GTA 6 gameplay videos apparently taken with a development build of the game, remains at large.

news.title: GTA 6 母公司负责人帮助制作了有史以来最好的圣诞电影之一
news.summary: One of the most memorable and beloved Christmas movies is 1990's Home Alone, but it almost didn't happen, and

content.v: One of the most memorable and beloved Christmas movies is 1990's Home Alone, but it almost didn't happen, and the head of GTA 6 's parent company played a role in bringing the movie to market.
Strauss Zelnick, the current CEO of Rockstar Games owner Take-Two, was the president and COO of 20th Century Fox at the time--he was among the youngest-ever Hollywood CEOs at the age of 32.

Warner Bros. was originally backing Home Alone and had actually begun production on the movie until budget concerns prompted the studio to pull the plug. "Four days into production, they shut down the picture and canceled it. That never happens," Zelnick told David Rubenstein .

Fox, under the leadership of chairman Joe Roth and Zelnick as president, swooped in and gave the filmmakers--including director Christopher Columbus and writer John Hughes--the money to make Home Alone.

That turned out to be a fantastic investment for Fox, as Home Alone ranked as one of the top five highest-grossing movies of the year in the US. It grossed more than $476 million globally against a $13 million budget, and it picked up two Oscar nominations. Home Alone also helped launch the career of Macaulay Culkin, and his role of Kevin remains his most memorable part.
So why didn't Zelnick keep making movies?

Zelnick was on top of the world as a film executive after Home Alone. However, he said he saw a bright future in the interactive entertainment business, so he left Fox in 1993 to join Crystal Dynamics where he served as president and CEO.

"I left Fox voluntarily, which no one ever does, to move to Silicon Valley, take a 95% pay cut and become the pre-revenue CEO of a little tiny video game company called Crystal Dynamics in 1993," he said in the Rubenstein interview.

After Crystal Dynamics, Zelnick shifted to the music business in the role of CEO as BMG Entertainment from 1994 to 2000. During that time, BMG started a gaming unit, BMG Interactive, which published the original GTA in 1997 .
After that, Zelnick and an investor group took over Take-Two, which was in a tough financial spot at the time and was sued by the US government for accounting fraud.

Since the takeover, Take-Two has thrived. Its share price exploded from about $10 in 2007 to more than $220 today, and Take-Two today has a market cap of over $40 billion. The GTA franchise is a juggernaut at Take-Two, but it actually only accounts for 15% of the company's revenue in a non-release quarter . Take-Two today owns and operates a number of big non-GTA franchises, including NBA 2K, Borderlands, Mafia, BioShock, Civilization, and more.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It's reportedly already sold close to 15 million copies and generated nearly $1.5 billion in revenue.

news.summary: Ghost of Yotei on PS5 has been discounted to $35 as part of PlayStation's Black Friday sale, making for a 50%

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/ghost-of-yotei-deal-1794842279840.jpg

PlayStation's Black Friday sale is in full swing now, featuring a variety of discounts on physical games, controllers , and more, alongside its previous drop of digital game deals . If you're on the hunt for the former, we've spotted many offers that are well worth your time already, including a 50% discount on Ghost of Yōtei .

Its physical copy is currently on sale for $35 as part of the sale, which is a huge drop from its original $69.99 MSRP and marks a brand new all-time low price for the game, according to our research. That's a pretty great Black Friday deal to have pop up, especially considering the game is only a year old. If you've been eager to pick it up for your PS5 library, now is the perfect time to strike.

It's certainly worth the cost, especially in the eyes of our reviewer , Michael Higham. Back when it was released, he gave the game an 8/10 and said that it features a "predictable but well-executed story" that "takes you through Ghost of Yotei's gorgeous landscapes and satisfying, fluid action combat." I managed to play through it earlier this year as well and certainly agree with Higham's thoughts here. If you enjoyed Tsushima, you're sure to have a blast running around in Yōtei.

PlayStation's Black Friday sale has plenty more video game deals to check out right now alongside Ghost of Yōtei, too. In terms of newer releases from this year, Marvel's Wolverine has dropped to $50 as part of the sale, and Saros has plummeted to $40.

There's also a solid selection of PS5 exclusives on sale for $30 or less right now, including big, beloved titles like God of War Ragnarok, Stellar Blade, and even Ghost of Tsushima (if you want to play Yōtei's predecessor). If you're in the shopping mood, it's a great time to stock up your PS5 library with some excellent new games.

news.title: 魔兽世界：永远的地下城又发生了巨大的变化
news.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's dungeons have changed once again, with developer Blizzard's most recent adjustmen

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever's dungeons have changed once again, with developer Blizzard's most recent adjustment requiring an emergency hotfix to address players' outcry.

Dungeons, specifically how much experience points players earn from them, have been one of Forever's most debated topics going back to the game's beta. Make them too lucrative, and players will just stay inside dungeons instead of questing out in the world. At the same time, Blizzard doesn't want dungeons to be one-time affairs, with players completing all their quests in a single run and never going back.

Blizzard opened a new front in the dungeon wars on November 13, making a change so that nobody in a dungeon group would receive any experience if enemies were considered "trivial" to to any player in the group. The idea behind this appeared to be an effort to prevent high-level players from running low-level ones through dungeons, in the process curtailing players from selling character "boosting" services to lowbies.

Unfortunately, far too many players playing the game normally were caught in the crossfire. Many of Forever's dungeons have double-digit level ranges, meaning even if a player might find enemies early on in the dungeon trivial, enemies and bosses later on won't be. It also created a scenario where players were leveling up mid-dungeon, only to suddenly find themselves fighting trivial enemies and bricking the experience gains for everyone in the group.

As it turns out, committing to a multi-hour adventure, only to suddenly find nobody is earning experience points and everyone is mad at you because you happened to level up, is not a great social experience. Blizzard was at least quick to admit the change "missed the mark" and made adjustments a day later on November 14.

"With hotfixes that are now live, we've just deployed a further change to this restriction, making it so the XP nullification only kicks in when the high-level player is more than 12 levels above the level of the enemies," Blizzard said in a forum post .
At least judging from forum comments, that seems to be a more reasonable compromise, even if it still does prevent higher-level players from coming to help their lower-level friends.

It's just the latest chapter in what has become one of the biggest ongoing discussions in the Forever community. During the Forever beta, Blizzard made changes to experience earned from dungeon quests, nerfing them significantly.

Come launch day, it became apparent Forever's dungeons weren't worth running more than once, as after completing quests, experience earned from kills was extremely low. Blizzard agreed, and issued a change on November 8 to increase the amount of kill experience earned in dungeons by 50%. It was a sizable increase, but is still lower than the experience amount players earned from doing dungeons in WoW Classic.

Forever's launch broke WoW concurrent-player records , and after one week of adventuring through Azeroth once more, classic WoW feels fresh again . Despite the record-breaking launch, Blizzard hasn't released official stats, but fansites have already pieced together the game's most popular class, race, and faction .

news.title: 我安装了一个《GTA 5》飙车模组，但被我的杀手模组巡回乐队搞砸了
news.summary: We've all been there.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Look, I'll be real with you. When I installed Drag Meets – Quick n Dirty Edition , I was not expecting it to go well. Cars spend most of their time flying and exploding in my copy of Grand Theft Auto 5, and these circumstances aren't conducive to gentlemanly racing.

I didn't anticipate it going quite as badly as it did, though. Drag Meets is actually rather complex: you don't just rock up to an objective marker, tap E, and get warped behind the wheel of a car. There's a lite social sim element to the whole thing, so you walk up to an objective marker, tap E, and suddenly find yourself standing in the midst of a drag racing soirée .

Drag meets are a scene, it turns out, and the scene's members have names, goals, and ambitions. A racer named "Blue Anime Panto" is seeking a challenger, the notifications inform me. "Blade had joined the meet", reads another. A lady called Tempesta has been forced to leave the meet because her engine broke, apparently. How did this happen? Either it's a randomly rolled event or her car flew into the sun; I am unable to tell.

It's not just Tempesta who's leaving the meet. Everyone is leaving, on account of the airborne minivan, just overhead, filled with hitmen determined to kill us all. They should be determined to kill me and only me, but Lamar (from GTA 5, you know? Lamar was also there. Keep up) began shooting back at them and all hell broke loose.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SMjzCgEyDYRmnjXM9DjSm9-1920-80.gif

The drag race—if it's even possible—never got the opportunity to start. Pretty soon, racing legends like Stinger GT and Rhapsody were face-down in the Los Santos grass. And then I teleported to the airport.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA-1920-80.jpg

content.v: 一款以“射击”为核心玩法的游戏，最不应该让玩家频繁产生的念头大概就是“希望自己能够少开几枪”。而《异界揭踪》（ ANOMALITH ）这款游戏，就恰好就给了我这样有点令人尴尬的感受。
https://image.gcores.com/fa163f4259aa8506e934cb444b6cf3e9-1200-630.png
作为 FuRyu 首次尝试的第三人称射击作品，它将生存、探索、资源收集和枪械改造等元素组合在一起，构建出了一个充满未知与危险的异常世界。但当用了十几个小时通关了本作之后，我发现最能吸引自己继续探索下去的，并不是它最核心的射击系统，而是那个充满谜团的世界，以及生活在其中的一群性格鲜明的人物。
换句话说，《异界揭踪》有一个相当有味道的故事，但最终游戏却并没有为这个故事提供足够出色的玩法支撑，以至于在我通关之后，只会觉得有点儿“遗憾”。
先决定一个“鲜明”的主题
在评价《异界揭踪》之前，我想先聊聊 FuRyu 这家公司。
https://image.gcores.com/fed2b00e30b0fbcce43c3518913147e9-576-180.png
对于经常接触日式主机游戏的玩家来说，FuRyu 应该算是一个比较特别的名字。它不像一些大型厂商那样拥有一套固定的热门游戏类型，而是更愿意在原创作品中尝试一些带有鲜明个人色彩的题材。这些作品的玩法类型各不相同，但都能很快让玩家找到一个记忆鲜明的主题。
这种创作思路其实也能从 FuRyu 公开的制作理念中得到印证。在之前的采访中不难看出，相较于大型的3A游戏，FuRyu 的原创作品会更加注重资源分配，希望将有限的制作时间与预算集中在核心概念和主题表达上，通过鲜明的创意与故事给玩家留下印象。
https://image.gcores.com/08bb1adc5d2693c17a2ed40e53b1bb66-1920-1080.jpg
当然，这并不意味着 FuRyu 所有作品都有着统一的开发风格，因为公司本身也会与外部开发团队合作。虽说具体项目的制作班底和玩法表现并不完全相同，但从这些原创作品中，我确实能够感受到一种类似的倾向：比起面面俱到，FuRyu似乎更愿意先找到一个足够有吸引力的创意，再围绕它来推进整个游戏的开发。
《异界揭踪》就是这样一款作品——它选择了一个并不常见的组合：昭和风格的架空日本、异常空间、少女主角，以及带有点儿生存恐怖色彩的第三人称射击。单从概念上看，这几种元素就足够让人产生好奇。
而在体验了游戏之后，我发现，它最值得肯定的部分，确实来自这些设定所构建出的故事与人物。
令人无法自拔的异常世界
《异界揭踪》的故事发生在一个昭和风格延续至近未来的架空日本。某一天，名为“异界”的特殊空间毫无征兆地出现在现实世界中。原本熟悉的公寓、医院、商店街，在异常力量的影响下发生扭曲，成为无法用常理解释的危险区域。
而这些地方并不完全是传统恐怖游戏里的废墟或鬼屋，它们依然保留着日常生活的痕迹，却又在空间结构上变得看起来有点儿“荒诞”：重力反转的住宅区、不断扭曲的走廊、仿佛永远没有尽头的商店街。这种熟悉与陌生之间的落差，构成了本作相当有辨识度的视觉氛围。
https://image.gcores.com/c27881530eacf44311045a6e2720686e-1920-1080.jpg
这种设计让《异界揭踪》拥有了一个很好的故事开端——玩家扮演的水无月玲绪奈，是一名17岁的少女。为了寻找在异界事件中失踪的好友华藤有沙，她主动加入了政府设立的危险区调查组织，成为一名进入异界执行调查任务的人员。
两人的关系，正是整个故事最重要的情感起点：玲绪奈曾经生活在糟糕的家庭环境中，甚至一度流落街头；而有沙则来自截然不同的成长环境，是一名出身优渥学校的学生。原本不应该产生太多交集的两个人，却在相处中成为彼此生命中最重要的朋友。
可一场异界化事件让她们被迫分离，寻找有沙，自然便成为了玲绪奈的唯一目标。
https://image.gcores.com/4bdd9ae92a0bb814f385861572a0eafc-1920-1080.jpg
这个动机其实并不复杂，但它很好地为故事提供了一个具体的情感落脚点。相较于拯救世界、调查未知现象这样宏大的目标，“一个人想要找回自己唯一的朋友”这种动机，反而更容易让我理解她为什么会愿意一次又一次地进入这个危险的区域展开冒险。而随着故事推进，玩家也会逐渐发现，玲绪奈所加入的组织并不是什么值得完全信赖的救世机构。
对于组织而言，进入异界的调查人员、以及困在其中的普通人，似乎都可以成为研究和收集数据的代价。这种有幕后黑手的反转，虽然看起来有点传统，但也多少能为这个灰色的故事线增加点儿意料之外的冲突。
那些围绕着主人公的配角，同样有不少值得挖掘的地方——负责与她保持联络的操作员，曾经也是深入异界的一线调查人员，却因为受伤不得不转到后方；组织的负责人有过漫长的异界求生经历，而研究部门的成员则对异常物品抱有近乎执着的兴趣。
https://image.gcores.com/a0757ca84627f4df8ef882afdc39af3d-1920-1080.jpg
每个人都有自己的经历，也有一套看待异界和生命的方式。值得一提的是，这些角色并不总是以传统意义上的好人形象出现。有些人看起来温和，却会做出相当危险的决定；有些人身处组织高层，却完全无法理解自己所面对的危险。
从整体的呈现来看，《异界揭踪》最成功的地方，我认为正是它没有把异常世界单纯当作一个展示怪物和场景的舞台，而是让它与人物的过去、选择以及彼此之间的关系产生联系。这是日系厂商一贯很擅长的叙事风格，本作自然也成为了他们施展这种长处的舞台。
当然，游戏的整体叙事并非没有问题。随着谜团逐渐展开，部分剧情的展开节奏会显得比较快，让一些配角没有获得足够充分的刻画。但在最重要的主角身上，本作至少建立起了一个足够明确的情感目标，让我在这十数个小时的游戏过程中，想要去关注她接下来等待着她的命运。
没能跟上时代脚步的射击系统
可惜的是，当我需要通过使用枪械去应对异界中的危险时，《异界揭踪》却暴露了出相当明显的问题。
从玩法结构来看，本作拥有一套看起来比较完整的循环：进入异界区域，调查环境、寻找资源、击败异常生物，再通过传送点带回物资，最后回到基地强化武器和装备。随着游戏推进，玩家还能够解锁不同枪械、配件和玲绪奈独有的异常化技能。这些系统本身并不缺少内容，甚至可以说形成了相当好的配合。
但关键的问题在于，它们并没有很好地转化成战斗中的乐趣。
https://image.gcores.com/d16c7d9dd283ea5fe68003a4899c7b86-1920-1080.jpg
最明显的问题来自角色的行动和射击之间缺乏足够流畅的衔接。玲绪奈的移动显得有些迟缓，面对敌人时缺少足够灵活的调整空间。尤其是在狭窄空间里遭遇敌人，或者同时被多个敌人包围时，我很难通过迅速移动来脱离危险。
而瞄准和射击的整体操作反馈也不够理想。准星调整、面对移动目标时的操作，以及攻击动作之间的衔接，都很难展现出那种行云流水的操作感。再加上换枪和装填所需要的时间，在战斗中，经常会出现一些会打断节奏的停顿。
需要强调的的是，游戏中并不是完全没有射击反馈。枪械本身的音效、命中反馈和后坐力设计并不是缺失的。真正的问题在于这些单独成立的反馈，并没有组合成一套足够舒服的操作体验。
https://image.gcores.com/085c25d5ef60123c83d738245520cc9c-1920-1080.jpg
更可惜的是，游戏的异常化技能原本有机会成为战斗系统的亮点。玲绪奈可以利用体内的异常力量发动近战攻击和防御能力，官方也为她准备了12种不同的技能。但在实际设计中，它与射击更像是两套各自独立的攻击手段，而不是一套可以自由衔接的战斗体系。
于是，女主角虽然拥有越来越多的装备和技能，却没有提供相应的在战术层面的乐趣。武器升级虽然可以让伤害数字变得更好看，却无法解决角色移动生硬、射击操作不顺手的问题。
https://image.gcores.com/ee99b678e7482fbe801cfe247e5caa33-1920-1080.jpg
这让本作的生存元素显得有些“尴尬”——游戏本来是想让玩家在资源管理和危险环境之间作出取舍，但当战斗本身不够有趣时，玩家对于面前的危险不是紧张，而是焦躁。
好在，本作的探索与资源收集还是具备一定可玩性的。在有限的携带空间内，玩家需要不断权衡哪些物资值得带走，哪些东西可以暂时舍弃，而回到基地之后，又能通过强化系统逐步提升角色的能力。这套局外成长机制设计得还算不错，也为每一次进入异界提供了比较明确的目标。
另外，不同武器、配件和装备之间也提供了一定的搭配空间，让玩家能够根据自己的习惯调整战斗配置。
https://image.gcores.com/258e699aa83c9233aca11cd6e77c1e7b-1920-1080.jpg
从这个角度来看，《异界揭踪》并不是缺少玩法内容，而是这些内容之间还没有形成足够成熟的体验。某种程度上，这也延续了 FuRyu 过往作品给我的印象：它总能拿出一些足够鲜明、让人眼前一亮的创意，也很擅长通过故事和角色建立作品的独特气质，但在具体的玩法打磨和整体完成度上，却往往还存在一些不容忽视的短板。长处足够鲜明，短板也同样明显。
https://image.gcores.com/d69e41fa81d2a0adbad40955a156a719-1920-1080.jpg
结语
《异界揭踪》是一款让我觉得有些可惜的作品。田中罗密欧的剧本、MON 的角色设计，以及围绕异界展开的种种谜团，都让游戏拥有了别样的魅力。但另一方面，FuRyu 却选择了一个对操作要求并不低的游戏类型。
第三人称射击不仅需要足够有趣的武器和敌人，更需要把移动、瞄准、攻击和防御这些最基础的环节打磨到位。遗憾的是，《异界揭踪》在这方面还有相当大的进步空间。
https://image.gcores.com/0c8f409f57300b8653a96654e587c64d-1920-1080.jpg
我并不觉得 FuRyu 需要把自己的原创作品都做成面面俱到的大型游戏。它过去那些能够让人记住的作品，恰恰是因为拥有足够鲜明的主题和个性。但创意终究需要玩法来承接，尤其是当一款游戏把射击放在核心位置时，光有一个好故事显然还是不够的。
这或许就是《异界揭踪》最让我觉得可惜的地方吧。

news.title: 《GTA 6》应该有助于提振 PS5 和 Xbox 的销量，但它们的天价价格可能会受到损害
news.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to help boost console sales for PS5 a

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to help boost console sales for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. But the uptick in hardware sales might not be as dramatic as you might think--and there is a good reason why.

According to Circana's Mat Piscatella , there will be "probably" be a boost to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S sales when GTA 6 comes out, but the uptick could be muted due to the recent PS5 and Xbox Series X|S price hikes. Piscatella said anyone who is excited for GTA 6 and needs a new console might think twice when they see how astronomically expensive new consoles have become today .
Historical prices

When GTA 5 launched in 2013, the average price paid for a new PS3 was $252 and the Xbox 360 was $232. Adjusted for inflation, that would be $363 for the PS3 today and $334 for the Xbox 360. Those prices are significantly below the average price of a new PS5 ($646) and Xbox Series X|S ($663) today.
"Not a good thing"

Earlier this year, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, who oversees the company launching GTA 6, said , "The rising cost of hardware is not a good thing." At the same time, Zelnick isn't worried about the impact on GTA 6, in part because he believes the game is so good that people will find a way to pay for a new console.

"However, a lower price point for hardware would be a good thing because there’d be more hardware in people’s hands," he said. "Probably the most relevant thing is the world continues to move to open systems, and that will continue.”

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. People in New Zealand get to play first, and if you're planning a trip to the land of Hobbits, here are some tips for safely packing your PS5.

news.title: 有人劫持了旧的 Bitly 链接，将大品牌重定向到 Skibidi 厕所和 Epstein 文件维基
news.summary: Even Steven from Mewgenics gets a shout out.

content.v: What do you mean bad actors I wasn’t doing that much bad things pic.twitter.com/swHfeOLTuV November 16, 2026

Bitly, the URL shortener website, got in hot water this week as users (or 'bad actors' as the company calls them) found out they could hijack old broken links and put whatever they like in their place. As you can imagine, chaos ensued.

Many of the links have since been fixed, but it seems like the McDonald's Twitter account once accidentally said the Swedish McDonald's team are responsible for 9/11,, and KFC linked to the Mewgenics wiki page for Steven, an NPC from the game. McDonald's was caught multiple times in this hijacking, with the Canadian X account hijacked to link the We Are Charlie Kirk song .
Though it's hard to verify now, it also seems like the Windows X page accidentally linked to the "r/FuckMicrosoft" subreddit too.

Big brands weren't the only ones caught in the mass hijacking. President Donald Trump seemingly tweeted a lot of Bitly links back in 2011, which were hijacked to instead link to a 'Trollface' meme song, a picture of a soggy cat titled "Soggy cat", and a link to the Epstein files Wikipedia page.
images for archival purposes pic.twitter.com/fRRr8LMGeE November 15, 2026

A day after this exploit started to make its way around X, Bitly shared that it had identified the issue and said, "We have suspended the accounts involved and are disabling the affected links. Our Trust and Safety team is working to address the issue and strengthen protections against similar misuse in the future."

It seems like the links in question were broken before being hijacked, and users simply managed to redirect those links to whatever site they wanted. However, in Bitly's documentation , it says the "back-halves used on these links cannot be re-used — whether they're automatically-generated or custom back-halves." So it's not entirely clear how these users manage to use links when Bitly says they supposedly cannot be reused.

Earlier today, we identified an issue that allowed bad actors to repurpose certain old, inactive links to redirect people to content unrelated to the original posts. We have suspended the accounts involved and are disabling the affected links. Our Trust and Safety team is working… November 15, 2026

In the grand scheme, brands linking to various songs and Wikipedia articles are relatively harmless, but the ability to hijack links does pose a problem: what if hackers could do the same with a link to something containing malware? As such, it's probably a good reminder to Bitly and any other URL shortener websites to double-check that users can't reuse old broken links, as who knows who could have possibly made them first.

news.title: 《最终幻想 14》一直在努力让 500 小时的故事变得不那么令人畏惧，这几乎在 8 月份就体现出来了，但 Yoshi-P 决定推迟它
news.summary: We'll get there… one day.

content.v: I love Final Fantasy 14. I can also recognise that for anyone trying to start the game in the big 2026, it's incredibly daunting. Being faced with A Realm Reborn and five entire expansions' worth of story is a lot, and the question of how to funnel new players into Eorzea in a more approachable manner while still respecting the MMO's heavily narrative-driven vibe has been an ongoing debate for the last several years.

We know, at the very least, that director and producer Naoki Yoshida has been thinking about ways to make that barrier to entry a little less frightening— he said as much during Final Fantasy 14's Berlin Fan Festival —but according to a recent Letter from the Producer , it turns out we could've actually had something as recently as August.

"The idea of letting players freely choose a starting point for their adventure has been discussed, with the goal being to offer players a range of choices, rather than prescribe their experience according to my philosophy," Yoshida wrote.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/iTHMbRserK3ZdNYWzRQfRh-1920-80.png

In case you're not familiar with Yoshida's whole stance on this, he's long been staunchly protective of Final Fantasy 14's narrative integrity. Story skips are locked to the cash shop and, up until now, never included the current expansion. He's repeatedly expressed the fact that he's not too keen on letting people jump in wherever they feel, since it kinda mucks up the decade-plus worldbuilding and character relationships the game has built.
But, like many things he's been opposed to introducing in the game like unlocked glamour, he's letting up for the sake of allowing players more agency in how they engage with the game.

Anyway, back to letting people tackle its immense story a little easier. "With New Game+ working smoothly, this approach could work," Yoshida surmised. "In fact, we'd been laying groundwork to make this a possibility in conjunction with the release of the Nintendo Switch 2 version, but ultimately decided to postpone this initiative."

I do wonder specifically what made them stop—whether there was a hiccup somewhere, or whether Yoshida simply decided now wasn't the right time. He also expresses concern about a mismatch in player skill between those who jump ahead and those who've been around the block. "Even if you could start adventuring from a point of your choosing, the time and effort required to master a job remain a constant," he wrote. "We also need to avoid situations where both new and veteran players are left confused when matched together."

I don't want to be the one to tell Yoshi-P that the mismatch is still there even among players who've been around a long time, but I've seen an awful lot of omni-level characters who can't even do their basic rotation. So there's that.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5BCLDn9uWa9YYLdeqYWPBL-1920-80.png

"However, with all these considerations in mind, we've held meetings to discuss system and tutorial improvements, and have set ourselves a significant goal for the future. Although we'll need more time to realise this goal, I think giving players more freedom in their adventures will ultimately prove a positive change."

Honestly? I think even without story skips, tutorialisation and job mastery need to be better woven into the fabric of the game. Its low-level Hall of the Novice misses crucial info and includes odd holdovers from the days of things like the TP resource and much tougher aggro management—there's no emphasis on the importance of healers dealing damage, and tanks are told to only use their AOE for aggro generation before switching to single target.

It's all well and good trying to help players understand their role, but not when the information is outdated and fails to include key responsibilities. The tactical training exercises introduced early in Dawntrail are much better, and show how helpful such tutorials can be when they're properly updated and in line with over a decade's worth of in-game culture and community expectations.

news.title: 魔兽世界的突袭即将变得更加容易
news.summary: As the second season of World of Warcraft Midnight winds down, it's clear that The Venomous Abyss was a bit ha

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/eclipse-vcms-1789245170445.jpg

As the second season of World of Warcraft Midnight winds down, it's clear that The Venomous Abyss was a bit harder than it should have been. And Blizzard is taking the opportunity to make its next raids easier.

Writing via Blizzard's WoW Forum entitled 'raid encounter design in Season 3', World of Warcraft developer Limestone discussed the direction for the final Midnight season, including some of the nerfs coming to The Venomous Abyss nearly three months after launch. The focus here is on "reducing the number of damage events that could kill you or your entire raid with a single individual mistake."

In Midnight's latest raid, The Venomous Abyss, there were a number of abilities, even on Heroic – WoW's middle-tier difficulty – that would wipe your group if you messed up. On the last boss, Ula'Tek, for instance, there were these little snakes that would hatch out of eggs in phase two. They had an ability, called Anguished Cry, that would deal half a million damage to each player within 60 yards and stun them for 6 seconds. That is less than a geared player's health pool, but the stun meant that if a single instance of that ability went off, it would just chain and spiral out of control, leading to the death of you and all of your friends. And that's just one example out of the eight-boss raid.
At least it seems like Blizzard is aware of the problem. In the post, Limestone says it went too far in designing punishing encounters.

"We feel that our design has shifted over time at the expense of the average Mythic player’s experience," Limestone wrote. "Going forward into Season 3, we’d like to intentionally pull back on some of these severe mechanical penalties, even at the start of the season."

The alternative that Blizzard is pitching is that each mistake will be less punishing, but can still spiral out of control. As Limestone stated, "for example, a small missile landing on a character should generally not kill an appropriately geared character from 100% HP. However, if every player in the raid collectively ignores Malacrass’ cast of Eternal Nightfall, he will eventually complete his cast and destroy the raid."

The goal, instead, is to make the successes and failures of raiding a little less binary. Rather than one player messing up a single mechanic and killing 20 people, there will be "fewer wipes that feel like “instant death” and more wipes that feel like a slow unraveling as the group makes mistakes and productively learns from them."

This isn't the first time that Blizzard has had to dial back difficulty in Mythic raiding, and it probably won't be the last. Even back in The War Within , Season 2's Liberation of Undermine raid was a huge step back in difficulty compared to Season 1's Nerub'ar Palace, which Blizzard then corrected with Season 3's Manaforge Omega, which will probably go down in history as one of the best raids of all time. Hopefully Midnight's next raid finds some middle ground once again.

The retail team is probably feeling some added pressure, too, thanks to WoW Forever . I know that I've taken a break from grinding Mythic+ dungeons and raiding in favor of leveling a new Mage on the Classic+ mode, and I know I'm not alone. Hopefully, when the final season of Midnight launches, it feels good enough that it sinks its claws back into me.

news.title: 作为大规模 Rockstar Games 合作的一部分，《NBA 2K27》将添加罪恶都市、GTA 6 主题化妆品等
news.summary: Vice City is coming to NBA 2K27 as part of a massive crossover with GTA 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/nbathumb-1794845245723.png
Vice City is coming to NBA 2K27 as part of a massive crossover with GTA 6 .

NBA 2K27's Season 3 update will arrive on November 27, and it's completely focused on GTA 6. The new update will take players to Vice City via a new park next to the city's park. The area features oddles of GTA imagery, including the Vice City blimp that has been flying around Miami in real life and a statue of Macca the Gator, a cartoon character in GTA 6 . Additionally, the season's rewards pass will also give you access to a wide variety of GTA-themed cosmetics and items, including new takeover abilities inspired by the game.

As one might imagine, fans will also be able to rep the new Miami Heat jerseys that were created in collaboration with Rockstar Games. On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a real, regular-season NBA game as the Vice City Heat , complete with new jerseys and a never-before-seen court. It should be quite the spectacle, and one that you will be able to at least partially recreate in-game.

Season 3 will last for seven weeks, and players can actually get in on the action without buying NBA 2K27. If you subscribe to Rockstar's subscription service, GTA+, you will be able to play NBA 2K27 for free from November 27 to January 15. Anyone who pre-orders GTA 6 on Xbox and PlayStation is entitled to a free one-month trial of GTA+, so this would be a great way to put it to use. Starting December 17, subscribers will also be able to take advantage of free GTA-themed items and bonuses in NBA 2K27. Ultimately, it seems like NBA 2K27 doesn't have to worry about fans deleting their games in the same way Madden does .

This update was teased earlier this fall when NBA 2K27 was released , but 2K and Rockstar Games kept a tight lid on what would actually be featured in the update. It appears that this is one of the final marketing beats for GTA 6, as the game will officially release this week. (I know, it's as crazy for me to write as it is for you to read.) The game will have a regional rollout, meaning that folks in New Zealand will technically start playing it a day before users in the United States (unless you take advantage of some loopholes).
GTA 6 is available to pre-load right now , and Rockstar has already pushed out a couple of updates , which fans will need to download before they play the game.

news.title: “这就像登月”：游戏顶级内容创作者如何为 GTA 6 的发布及后续版本做准备
news.summary: GTA 6 is finally almost here, and the world's biggest content creators are trying to figure out how to handle

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/gta-6-pre-load-art-1794330386826.jpg

GTA 6 is finally upon us and it’s expected to be a cultural juggernaut that overshadows everything in its path. This includes other game releases, movies, and even upcoming holidays, such as Thanksgiving in the United States. Economists estimate a $1 billion loss in productivity during the game’s launch weekend , as millions of people are expected to take time off work to play Rockstar’s highly anticipated game. All in all, it's hard to overstate the impact its arrival will have.

“To me, every GTA feels like a generational moon landing,” said Mary Kish, the Head of Community Marketing at Twitch. “It's so big, and it's so prolific, and it changes culture and my life to such a large extent that it can feel overwhelming.”

However, there is one group of people that are going to be working non-stop for the next month: content creators. Typically, content creators are given games earlier so they can make all kinds of videos about the game. I spoke with some of the top YouTubers and streamers in the world, including in the GTA space, and none of them have the game. That even goes for a popular GTA YouTuber known as TGG, who has 2.32 million subscribers. He was exclusively invited to Rockstar North over the summer to be one of the only people to see GTA 6 before its release and became a primary source for anyone seeking information about the elusive game. And yet, Rockstar withheld the full game even from him.

This isn’t common for a major AAA video game. It shows the lengths Rockstar is going to to preserve and protect its blockbuster, which has been guarded with a veil of secrecy for most of the last decade. Rockstar has been very calculated with how and when it chooses to show what it has been working on. The company has subtly sprinkled short gameplay clips and teasers in the final days before release , but that’s about it. There aren’t any YouTubers who have weeks of uploads banked and ready to go, meaning almost everyone is going into this game completely blind and on the same level playing field.

That has presented a unique situation for a lot of these creators. Everyone I spoke with made it clear that this is a game they are genuinely excited for. Although they have a job to do, they have all waited years for this moment as a fan. Despite the pressure to make content, they all told me they plan to take their time with the game so they can savor it, with some of them estimating that it may take over 100 hours before they actually roll credits on it.

A lot of preparation is going into this launch weekend. Some creators are hiring extra help in the form of additional writers and editors, while others are planning on making a spectacle out of things. Numerous streamers have rented properties in Miami to not only do massive, extravagant streams, but also celebrate the launch with others in person.

Audio tech company JBL, for instance, is sponsoring an event in Miami where streamers like Cody 'Clix' Conrod will be playing the game together and will be doing a meet-and-greet at a Micro Center in the city. JBL is using the game's launch as an opportunity to advertise its new JBL Quantum 950X headset.

“I'm especially excited to bring some of my favorite creators together in Miami for a full day of gaming, where we'll be jumping into GTA 6 for the first time, streaming, capturing content and sharing our reactions," said Conrod. "It's going to be an incredible way to experience the game with the JBL community and beyond.”

“GTA 6 represents a landmark moment for gaming culture, bringing together creators and friends of the brand around one of the most highly anticipated releases in entertainment," said Bryce Showalter, JBL's Head of Gaming. "At JBL, we're always looking for ways to show up for the gaming community beyond the headset, creating experiences that connect our technology with the people and cultural moments shaping the industry.

"Our longstanding partnership with Clix is a great example of that commitment, and we’re excited to bring that relationship to life in Miami through opportunities for fans to connect with Clix firsthand at Micro Center, alongside exclusive creator experiences and day-of-release content. JBL is showcasing how Quantum is helping power cultural moments and deliver the immersive audio and all-day comfort players need to stay locked into the game.”
Introducing the Midnight Launch, in celebration of the release of GTA VI Exclusive prizes, game giveaways, merch, and more In Miami, November 18th-19th. Presented by HyperX https://t.co/fYk4LqHSZZ

Gaming peripheral company HyperX is teaming up with Gaming World Media to host a flashy in-person midnight launch event in Miami with fans and streamers. This is not something being done in partnership with Rockstar. It’s just a group of creators and a gaming hardware company putting their money together to do something special. According to GWM co-founder Jake Lucky, the goal is to recapture the magic of a shared in-person gaming experience.

“Essentially we are throwing a party for people who are just as excited for GTA as we are,” said GWM co-founder Jake Lucky in a statement to IGN. “[We are giving] attendees not only a chance to play, but also [a chance to] win their own copy, exclusive merch, and even GTA inspired collectibles to remember the event by. I just really think it’s important to bring back the human aspect of game launches that we have lost in modern times”

This is a big moment for Twitch itself, as GTA 5 has remained a titan on the platform for years. Users have watched around 9 billion hours of the game and 1.7 billion of those hours came in 2025. Kish kept wanting to stress that this moment is “akin to a moon landing” and compared it to a seismic entertainment moment like a new Star Wars or Lord of the Rings film. As a result, they need to make fans feel that on Twitch.

“It's our responsibility as Twitch to say, ‘How do we show up and give them the best GTA experience known to man?’” said Kish. “How do we make this feel reactive and interactive, not passive? Because that's not what we do here. And how do we make you feel like you can be a part of the biggest thing on the planet?”

Twitch is putting all of its energy and money into supporting this launch. Despite not having any official partnership with Rockstar Games, the streaming platform has created custom GTA 6-themed badges that will display next to users who are present for streams of the game during November. The idea is to give fans something similar to signify they were there for a major moment in entertainment history. The company is also giving out 10,000 copies of the game’s Ultimate Edition to random users throughout the month.

Twitch began making its plans “well over six months ago,” according to Kish. Once it became clear that GTA 6 wouldn’t be delayed again, the team began trying to make whatever preparations that it could.
“The GTA tsunami is going to hit us like a ton of bricks and we have to mentally and physically prepare everybody,” said Kish. “All hands on deck, every chef in the kitchen.”

news.title: EA 恳求您不要删除《GTA 6》中的《Madden 27》
news.summary: We all know what's coming: Grand Theft Auto 6 . Whether you're ready for it or not, the most anticipated game

content.v: We all know what's coming: Grand Theft Auto 6 . Whether you're ready for it or not, the most anticipated game of the decade is preparing to launch on November 19, and ahead of its release, EA is begging you to please not ditch footballs for guns.
According to Push Square , EA added a "don't delete" pop-up message to Madden NFL 27 . The pop-up says there's an update coming to the football simulator on November 17, just before GTA 6 drops.

"Don't delete," the message reads. "[Encrypted Signal] The target is locked. The crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await the signal from our insider on 11/17 ... do not leak this transmission!"

In a November 10 post on Madden NFL 27's official X account , EA said that a throwback Madden 97 update is coming on November 18 with old-school playbooks, 16-bit gameplay, and the All '97 Team. Underneath that post, EA had asked that you stick around a little while longer.

This is in reference to the humongous amount of storage space that Rockstar Games' GTA 6 will take up when it launches. Start clearing out your hard drive now because you need at least 212GB of free space to download GTA 6. In comparison, Madden NFL 27 needs approximately 60GB to install the game.

If you're like me and you still have the base PS5, this means you have approximately 667GB of usable space. Sure, you can fit both GTA 6 and Madden NFL 27 on the same console. However, if you have any other recent releases like The Blood of Dawnwalker (~50GB), Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen (~81GB), Phantom Blade Zero (~135GB), and Valor Mortis (~60GB), then you can see how quickly you'll run out of space--especially since you have to leave a little wiggle room for game updates, too. That's not to mention the games dropping in 2027, such as Final Fantasy VII Revelation , which game director Naoki Hamaguchi said could be around 200GB .

EA has recently gone through a restructuring that saw 400 employees across the company get let go and the legendary studio BioWare get shut down . In the midst of this, the publisher reiterated its commitment to the Madden franchise with a new title currently codenamed Project Gridiron. While filled with potential, we do fear that EA's plan for the series may lean into everything that the company itself does wrong .

news.title: Rockstar 本来可以比 GTA 5.5 更早发布 GTA 6，但“你必须做出重大调整”
news.summary: After years of development, multiple delays, and loads of hype, Rockstar Games is finally releasing Grand Thef

content.v: After years of development, multiple delays, and loads of hype, Rockstar Games is finally releasing Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19. What took so long?

According to Rockstar publishing executive Jennifer Kolbe, the team at Rockstar "could have made GTA 5.5, and done it faster." However, "Ultimately, that's not what they wanted," she told The Guardian .

Rockstar boss Rob Nelson, meanwhile, said it was important for the studio to go above and beyond with GTA 6, and that takes time. "You have to take big swings. It can’t be just more of the same," he said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Jason_and_Lucia_13.jpg?w=636

GTA 6 looks to be a big step up from GTA 5 in a number of ways, including the visuals and technical improvements . Beyond that, the story this time around is a Bonnie-and-Clyde-style narrative about a crime-loving couple-- Jason and Lucia . It's also the first time Rockstar is releasing a GTA game with a playable female protagonist.

GTA 6 took so long to come out because Rockstar is seeking "perfection," according to Take-Two. “The team at Rockstar really does seek to do something that’s never been done before. That’s really hard and it takes a long time,” he said.

Rockstar and its owner, Take-Two, stand to benefit greatly from what's expected to be a commercial blockbuster with GTA 6. But could future GTA game releases come at a faster pace? According to Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, the "nature and velocity" of GTA releases will look "dramatically different" over the next decade, but he didn't share more or commit to any specific timelines.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. People in Australia can attend a funeral at KFC to get the day off work to play it.
GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time and not simultaneously around the world. This means people in the US will be among the last in the world to get to play .

news.title: 我们几乎得到了中世纪的《使命召唤》，其中有骑士和剑：“如果这是一个战争故事，当然，它可以是《使命召唤》”
news.summary: Instead we just got more guns.

content.v: Call of Duty is an inherently conservative series. You know what you're getting: guns, explosions, cinematic flourishes inspired by action movies, and probably some jingoism. And that's largely what the annual series' adherents seem to want. But it could be so much more.

Taylor Kurosaki, writer and co-director for Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare , tells us he still thinks it has broad potential. That's why Infinite Warfare was set in the future—though, at the time, the team didn't realise it would end up being the third futuristic CoD, following Advanced Warfare and Black Ops 3.

"Look, Call of Duty is a massive tree with a lot of branches, right? It can be World War 2. The team at IW had prototyped a medieval Call of Duty. Where you were a knight and had a sword and all kinds of crazy shit. But if it's a war story, sure, it can be Call of Duty."

I would love for that to be true. Call of Duty: The American Revolutionary War, Call of Duty: The Hundred Years War, Call of Duty: Napoleon. A military romp that isn't set between 1941 and 2065. After 23 years, it would be nice to see it spread out a bit.

But big swings are not in CoD's nature. Or rather, Activision isn't particularly interested in rocking the money boat. A medieval CoD isn't the only massive detour the series almost took. Before it was forced to salvage Infinity Ward's Modern Warfare 3, Sledgehammer was working on a third-person horror game set in Vietnam, called Call of Duty: Fog of War .

"We wanted to make a scary version of Vietnam," Sledgehammer co-founder Glen Schofield told us last year. "And not just scary, we wanted intense battles that were personal, but stuff you've never seen before. We were making it, and we were really psyched about having you go through tunnels, and everything is scary because there's not much light down there. Sometimes you're shooting in the dark."

When Vince Zampella and Jason West left Infinity Ward amid a legal dispute, Activision told Sledgehammer to drop their project and pivot to Modern Warfare 3. It was never allowed to return to Fog of War.

news.title: 映泰宣布推出首款英特尔 Panther Lake 主板，虽然体积很小，但不要抱太大希望将其塞进迷你游戏 PC 中
news.summary: A mini PC with Intel's G3 chip would rock, but alas, we're left with just four Xe3 cores instead.

content.v: Motherboard manufacturer Biostar has just announced the BIPTL-IHT, a mini motherboard complete with an integrated Panther Lake-H processor. It's the first desktop Panther Lake motherboard to be released in retail.
As spotted by VideoCardz , the motherboard range has support for up to 128 GB of DDR-7200 MHz SO-DIMM memory and can come with the following chips:

All of these chips come with Xe3 graphics with four Xe cores, and are lacking the punchy integrated B390 iGPU (and its 12 Xe3 cores) that some mobile Panther Lake chips have. You can still do some light gaming on these integrated graphics, but you won't be making yourself a mini gaming PC with Biostar's latest.

Instead, it seems like the purpose of this motherboard is to support industrial PCs, but given Xe3 graphics support hardware-accelerated AV1 encoding and decoding, one could feasibly use the motherboard in a mini media server PC instead.

You are getting two M.2 Key-M slots here, with PCIe 5.0 x4 and PCIe 4.0 x2 connections. This allows for NVMe storage, and the memory is dual-channel too. You also get two HDMI ports, two DisplayPort 1.4 ports, and the motherboard can support up to four displays at once.
As it's a 'Thin' Mini-ITX motherboard, its dimensions are 170 mm by 170 mm. That's very small. We don't yet have a release date or price point for this motherboard range.

Still, it's a bit of a shame we don't have any mini motherboards with gaming-worthy integrated Panther Lake mobile chips yet. Especially as GPU prices are so high. I managed to get the chance to test out the Intel G3 Extreme in the Acer Predator Atlas 8 handheld, and it's pretty incredible for a chip with integrated graphics. It rocks both gaming and productivity tasks, given the size and heat.
If it's good enough for gaming laptops, I'd say it's good enough for an itty bitty PC to hook up to your TV. Let's hope we don't have to wait too long for a motherboard with one of those in.

news.title: 《足球经理》熬了两年，总算重归正轨
news.summary: 对话FM27开发团队。 对许多玩家来说，每年购买和游玩新一代的《足球经理》（以下简称 FM），早已成为了一种习惯。但这种习惯，偏偏在过去两年里被打破了。 2024年，FM系列的开发商Sports Interactive（

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/a2e36101d8d7fcd15522852bbbc935db.jpg_mw680water
对话FM27开发团队。
对许多玩家来说，每年购买和游玩新一代的《足球经理》（以下简称 FM），早已成为了一种习惯。但这种习惯，偏偏在过去两年里被打破了。
2024年，FM系列的开发商Sports Interactive（SI）宣布，要将游戏用了多年的自研引擎更换为Unity。
这导致FM25跳票乃至被取消，最终上线的FM26尽管在画面表现方面有了提升，但UI界面的排布和操作逻辑被大改——增加大量卡片磁贴和多级菜单，导致众多玩这款游戏玩了近十年的玩家们，甚至“玩不明白”了。
尽管期间进行多次弥补性更新，但在发售一年后，FM26在 Steam 上的好评率仍旧只有36%，“多半差评”，足以让人担心下一代新作该怎么办。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/fd5f46c35b43bb37805565ebc5ee09ad.jpg_mw680water
《FM26》在 Steam 上的总体评价为“多半差评”
在11月11日FM27正式发售之前，SI首先面向所有玩家推出了一个限时5天的售前预览版，除了少数版权内容和功能未开放之外，基本就是个完全体的游戏，给大家畅玩——这是SI此前从未有过的尝试，为其拉了一波好感。
更让老玩家们重拾信心的，则是FM27的UI基本回归了FM24的直观布局，重启了顶部菜单，操作逻辑也变得更加扁平。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/010315644ff643d16e0f4b9f15f54f23.jpg_mw680water
《FM27》的经理中心。阵容、战术等入口集中在顶部，下方显示消息、赛程和积分榜
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/5e676b7d8672a0ef5fb6297673da321f.jpg_mw680water
在存档开始前，便可定制信息流的推送频率
这种“化繁为简”“尊重玩家操作效率”的思路，也延续到了一些新改动上。比如实况模式下，可以直接做出“战术微调”的指令，省去了去完整战术界面的步骤。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/827de2b8f279ff47f840b038631ac36b.jpg_mw680water
更重要的是，随着经典UI回归，玩家社区里自定义皮肤的作者们也不用再费劲帮官方找补，能腾出手来尝试一些新东西，如此费劲换新引擎的作用终于开始显现出来。
基于对Unity样式表（USS）与框架（如BepInEx）功能更深入的开发，FM27的玩家社区里不仅迅速涌现出包括俱乐部主题色及复古布局在内的、改变视觉效果的皮肤，也出现了具有改变玩法潜力的 皮肤 ：比如 隐藏了球员具体能力星级与具体数值，将其替换为文字描述、高阶数据统计与披萨图，要靠玩家自行推测的皮肤。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/8c9060f26cbd40d512849e29d5893cf4.jpg_mw680water
这一切也很快体现在了FM27风评上。到目前为止，游戏在 Steam 上获得了“特别好评”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/348802e71a1566538d531bbe49dd50e5.png_mw680water
《FM27》发售初期在 Steam 上获“特别好评”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/b2c08e02d16c6799b2f35c9c1d568f4e.jpg_mw680water
有玩家在 Steam 评测里提到了界面和流畅度的改善
对比FM26发售首日超过8万人的Steam同时在线峰值，FM27虽受好评，但人气却有所回落，明显还是在给上一作的口碑还债——平心而论，只是这样小幅的下跌，FM的忠实玩家真的是足够宽容，更应该被好好对待。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/e745764e96309048630c2ed2b20a85f4.png_mw680water
在FM27的整个开发周期里，SI都相当低调，线上线下几乎都没有做什么对外宣传。直至游戏发售前两周，我们才在北京的一场线下试玩会上见到了主创团队。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/b0311efb0ef4edd6eb32e837cd365281.jpg_mw680water
他们在采访中直面了上一代的争议，讲述了团队理念经历这一切后产生的一些新理解和想法——无论是关于UI的设计理念，还是对于和玩家社区创作的关系的思考。
我想这个故事能带给他们以及业界的一个共同的教训是：无论你对产品在某个大方向、尤其是技术面上做调整的必要性有多笃定，也不能忽略在具体细节上给游戏体验带来的影响，就像团队在采访最后所说的：你不该指望去向玩家们强调和说明某个游戏有多好，玩家的体验和感受，才是最真实的。
以下为此次采访原文，为便于阅读进行了一定程度的删减和调整：
Q：《FM26》发售后的争议很大。回头看从自研引擎全面转向Unity的过程，你们当时低估了哪些挑战？《FM27》里你们最希望解决什么？
A： 最大的挑战确实来自新引擎，尤其是 UI 向新工具和新技术体系迁移。
我们需要用新的引擎重新构建整个界面，同时重新构建游戏中的很多部分。过去一年，我们花了大量时间建立这些技术基础。到了《FM27》，我们才真正能够从“如何使用新技术”，转向“如何利用这些技术提升游戏体验”。
从社区反馈来看，UI是最大的痛点之一，包括操作效率以及老玩家对熟悉度的反馈。新玩家和老玩家对《FM26》的反应并不完全一样，因为很多老玩家原本熟悉的操作方式发生了变化。
所以《FM27》最重要的改进之一，就是让界面更好地服务不同类型的玩家，同时提升游戏的沉浸感。从长远来看，《FM26》的工作也为未来5年、10年，甚至20年建立了技术基础。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/a6b2260c2fa3b35b430b9e18a54c8367.jpg_mw680water
《FM27》的比赛日画面
Q：今年你们开放了免费试玩，甚至不需要预购就能体验，这个决定是否也是为了给玩家重新建立信心？
A： 对我们来说，现在最重要的一件事就是更早地把游戏展示给玩家。
我们希望通过实际体验来证明游戏，而不是只告诉玩家“我们做得很好”。此前发布的玩法视频，也尽量让真正负责相关功能的开发者来解释自己做了什么、为什么这么做。
免费试玩实际上就是这一策略的延伸，我们希望把决定权交给玩家。我们可以告诉你我们认为《FM27》是一款好游戏，但最终还是应该由玩家自己来玩，然后告诉我们到底喜不喜欢它。
如果玩家试玩之后仍然不喜欢，那就意味着我们还有更多工作要做，需要重新赢得他们对这个系列的支持。所以这就是一次真正的“先玩后买”。
Q：《FM26》的UI是社区争议最多的问题，尤其是一些常用功能被放进二级甚至三级菜单，《FM27》在这些方面具体做了哪些改变？此外玩家很关心Mod、头像包和皮肤包，今年有什么变化？
A：我们今年重新思考了UI导航和信息之间的关系。
《FM26》的一个问题，就是同时使用信息卡片进行导航，两个功能放在一起的信息效率并不高。
所以《FM27》把主要导航集中到了顶部，而顶部以下的区域更多用于展示信息，让玩家阅读、理解，并根据这些信息做决定。这是我们从《FM26》得到的一个重要经验：必须把“导航”和“信息”分开。
我们也非常重视效率、可预测性和熟悉感。玩家应该能够快速找到自己想做的事情，也应该知道点击之后会发生什么。对于回归的 FM 玩家，我们希望有一种“回到家”的感觉。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14634/013fc4f9795bc3762bc77ca36934d7da.png_mw680water
青训主管的职员页面。与年轻球员共事、判断球员潜力等能力以数值显示
至于Mod，因为版权和授权方面的限制，我们无法主动支持或者鼓励 Mod。但我们也不希望阻碍社区进行有趣的创作。《FM27》在偏好设置中恢复了“重载皮肤”按钮，这应该能让使用Mod自定义的玩家更加方便。
玩家对这些改动的反馈
Q：从《FM26》开始，比赛日的画面和动作有了明显提升。但从《足球经理》的玩法来看，玩家真正能够在比赛过程中进行的操作，是否也会有所增加？
A： 其实我们已经做了不少改变。《FM26》中就重新加入了“场边喊话”功能，因为我们知道玩家希望在比赛过程中拥有更多互动，不只是旁观，而是能够作为经理参与比赛。
《FM27》又进一步改进了这个系统。现在玩家的操作可以更直接地影响球员的肢体语言以及他们在球场上的行为。例如“战术微调”功能，它可以让经理在比赛过程中更快调整战术指令，而不需要重新进入完整的战术界面。
我们的目标，是让玩家能够更及时地应对比赛场景和对手的战术变化。
Q： 女足加入FM系列已经是第二年了，《FM27》在这方面的玩法和联赛上有哪些变化？
A： 我们一直有一个明确理念：男足和女足应该属于同一个世界、同一个生态系统。足球就是足球。作为经理，无论管理男足还是女足，使用的战术逻辑应该是相同的。真正的区别，只存在于现实世界中男足和女足确实存在不同的地方。
例如今年FIFA针对女足国家队实施了一些新规定，我们也会把现实中的规则变化加入游戏。当然，女足在底层也会体现现实中的差异。比如比赛动画会分别使用男足和女足真实比赛素材，因为两者在身体形态和动作方式上存在差异。
转会和合同也是一个例子。女足球员通常签订更短的合同，自由球员和自由转会的情况也更多，这些现实差异都会进入游戏。至于增加新的女足联赛，我们仍然在持续推进。但难点不仅是获得授权，还要确保联赛拥有足够的研究深度，达到FM系列一贯的标准。

others.title: 网易《哈利波特》官宣停运！大量活动开放最后一舞

content.v: 今日（11月16日），网易旗下《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》发布公告。公告表示，因授权协议到期，游戏将于2027年3月3日起正式停止运营。游戏将于2026年12月21日停止充值、新用户注册，并从全平台下架。2027年3月3日正式关闭服务器，并停止角色交易等相关服务。
《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》于2021年9月9日在中国大陆及港澳台地区上线。游戏将卡牌收集、即时对战与角色扮演结合起来，玩家可以在霍格沃茨体验课程、探索禁林，并通过收集魔法卡牌参与决斗。游戏采用的复古手绘美术风格，也是当时产品宣传中的一个重要特色。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14636/d57c637e9d6acb1d237a55dc64b63ecf.jpg_mw680water
游戏上线初期迅速取得市场成绩，连续霸占iOS畅销榜榜首一周。Sensor Tower在2021年11月发布的数据称，游戏上线首31天在App Store和Google Play获得1.807亿美元玩家消费；上线不到两个月累计玩家消费超过2.28亿美元。
《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》的上线，也让网易Zen工作室迎来了成立以来的第二次组织升级。2021年11月，游戏上线不到两个月，网易便宣布将原海神事业部旗下的Zen工作室升格为公司一级事业部，工作室负责人金韬同时晋升为事业部总裁。此前，金韬带领团队于2016年推出《阴阳师》，并凭借这款产品将原G37项目组发展为Zen工作室。
《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》也尝试过拓展海外市场。2023年6月27日，网易与华纳兄弟游戏宣布在全球多个地区推出游戏，双方共同负责开发和发行。不过，这次全球发行并未持续太久。2024年8月，华纳宣布游戏将在美洲、欧洲和大洋洲下架并停止内购，同年10月29日正式关闭当地服务器。当时，中国大陆、港澳台及部分亚洲和中东、北非地区的服务仍然保留。
2025年4月，Zen事业部更名为阴阳师事业部。负责人金韬当时表示，将重新接管《阴阳师》的运营，相关组织调整主要围绕《阴阳师》项目展开，《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》等其他项目暂不受影响。
本次停运也意味着游戏剩余运营区域将陆续结束服务。从全球发行到海外服务器关闭，再到中国大陆等地区停止运营，这款曾经取得过一定商业成绩的哈利波特IP手游，最终还是没能延续长线运营。
至于停运后玩家账号数据、未使用的游戏货币及其他虚拟资产将如何处理，官方目前尚未给出具体方案。
以下为公告原文：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14636/94fd3e8540bd163d64a9a885d808d22b.jpg_mw680water

news.title: 曾经最好的“电影改编游戏”之一，现在看更是超前
news.summary: 三十年河东，三十年河西。 2010年，在动画电影《玩具总动员3》正式上映日的3天前，迪士尼为其发行了一款同名游戏，由雪崩工作室负责开发。 这是曾经风靡一时的做法，被称为“电影联动游戏”（Movie Tie-In Game

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/b2480f53610a635df2cdd94e1c4672c0.jpg_mw680water
三十年河东，三十年河西。
2010年，在动画电影《玩具总动员3》正式上映日的3天前，迪士尼为其发行了一款同名游戏，由雪崩工作室负责开发。
这是曾经风靡一时的做法，被称为“电影联动游戏”（Movie Tie-In Games）。包括《黑客帝国2》《钢铁侠》《蜘蛛侠3》等电影，都曾在电影上映的同一天推出同名的衍生游戏，既为电影造势，也能作为周边带来一些额外创收。
你对其中的大部分可能完全没有印象——原因也很简单，因为这类游戏作为电影的衍生品，受限于成本、档期、剧情要紧扣电影内容等条件，要么是游戏性太弱，要么是内容量太小，要么是兼而有之……总之质量普遍不高，不乏粗制滥造，对当时的中国玩家而言，属于连盗版都没人下载的那类。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/359797963fda1af3530193adb2282a74.png_mw680water
例如《哈利·波特与死亡圣器（下）》的改编游戏主线时长甚至还没电影本身长，风评也可想而知
但《玩具总动员3》的改编游戏是少数例外之一。
雪崩工作室用真正属于游戏的关卡语言，重新设计了电影中几个令人印象深刻的场景——有射击，有解谜，有2D和3D的平台跳跃，不同角色有不同特性，甚至还有坐骑……可玩性相当高。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/6e740c79e70e15320877783eb73ae694.jpg_mw680water
更重要的是，除了主线关，游戏里还加入了一个名为“玩具箱”的沙盒模式——玩家从一个西部小镇起步，通过完成各种任务，来给这个小镇添加新建筑；而随着版图扩张，场景甚至能延伸到太空港——内容丰富度远超大家预期。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/28317c88afccfb61ce160c4d99f37a4d.jpg_mw680water
玩具箱模式的西部小镇
这个模式甚至还支持双人合作，玩家可以一人在家建小镇，一人出去完成任务。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/d319b6d0c3aafa4f8ecc363d9b621d1d.jpg_mw680water
最新移植版画面
这部改编作在当年的销量和口碑都不错，成为不少欧美玩家重要的童年回忆，同时也留下了遗憾——游戏里的部分内容由PS3和Xbox 360独占，Wii和PC版本都有残缺，而随着这些主机退役，大家很难再玩到完整版本。
直到《玩具总动员5》上映的今年，10月15日，由 Digital Eclipse 开发、与雅达利联合发行的《玩具总动员3：完整版》登陆主机和 Steam。
这次的完整版以当年内容最丰富的版本为移植基础，并优化了美术素材。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/3da5992b3141aa6102129c732a44d82a.gif_mw680
同一天还上架了另一部经典合集《玩具总动员：复古大集合》（Disney•Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!），打包收录了初代《玩具总动员》等早期作品的主机与掌机版本，包含了即时存档和“倒带”功能。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/bc5e277790f12e81e6e9be652c7ef444.jpg_mw680water
雅达利和Digital Eclipse已合作推出多部经典老游戏的移植作品，《玩具总动员》系列则已成为目前其中评价最高的作品，也算是终于争了口气。
抛开情怀，如今玩起来，其实也能感受到这部《玩具总动员3》除了沙盒玩法，还有不少别的超前之处——比如双人玩法下的一些互动设计，已经能让人想到后来的《双人成行》。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/752fd7fe2ec179ded489697d895dd56b.jpg_mw680water
这本身也是2010年前后游戏界的一股潮流，包括早一年发售的《生化危机5》、同年的《失落的星球2》，都在做全程双人甚至多人合作搭档通关的尝试。
但即便在这样的风向下，也没有哪家开发商敢做一款一定要两名玩家来配合通关的游戏，致使这类玩法始终颇为鸡肋——倒是更凸显了后来《双人成行》开发商Hazelight的魄力和含金量。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/9f1b92681cd2c94bee0991810a51a435.png_mw680water
Hazelight的第一部双人合作作品《逃出生天》
另一件令人颇为感慨的事，则是这类曾经蔚然成风的“电影联动游戏”，如今几乎已经绝种了。
除了因为质量普遍不高自砸了招牌之外，很大程度上也是因为这个生态位基本被手游、网游联动取代，以及如今电影的制作成本、影响力和商业价值越来越赶不上游戏，更常见的反而是将电影作为游戏的衍生品推出。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14635/b97189dbd64129f88b73cf246c4ef73c.jpg_mw680water
正在拍摄中的《塞尔达传说》电影
真可谓是三十年河东、三十年河西。

news.title: 侠盗猎车手复活节彩蛋的历史
news.summary: We explore the inside jokes and little secrets tucked in every corner of the GTA maps.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/gta-easter-eggs-blogroll-1794841916182.jpg

When you’ve got an open world as big and dense as Grand Theft Auto, you’ve got to fill it with something. Restaurants, tennis courts, hidden packages, Strangers and Freaks. All kinds of treats to reward our exploration, some buried deeper than others. From hearts and minds to signs and shrines, the inside jokes and little secrets Rockstar’s calling card tucked in every corner of the map. This is the history of Grand Theft Auto easter eggs.
Part 1: Gouranga!
The top-down Grand Theft Autos are too sparse and pixelated for the kind of buried treasures that would await us in the 3D era, but easter eggs exist even in this perspective.

The most famous secret of the first GTA games involves lines of chanting bald NPCs dressed in orange robes, evocative of the Hare Krishna devotees famous for descending upon travelers at airports. If you can run the entire procession down sequentially, you’re rewarded with a seemingly nonsensical shout of “GOURANGA!” The phrase, a Krishna term meaning “be happy,” became the series’ signature meme among the early fanbase and resurfaced in the first few sequels, with hidden bonuses for mowing down Elvis impersonators in GTA 2 and football hooligans in GTA: London.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/gta-easter-eggs-gouranga-1794843358242.jpg

For a series so devoted to examining the American dream, it’s easy to forget that Grand Theft Auto is British-born. The Scottish studio that created the series and the English brothers who made it a phenomenon belong to a storied Britdev tradition of taking the mick in the margins. From the ZX Spectrum emulator Rare buried in GoldenEye to Team17’s profane cheat codes and salty rants against Amiga Power magazine, British studios excel at hiding cheeky winks within their games. DMA Design, later Rockstar North, is no exception.

DMA logos are disguised among the scenery, the pager randomly rags on staffers, and director Keith Hamilton himself sends you on a mission to find “the elements of GTA.” You can unlock R-rated language by naming your character after the studio’s credited “Project Bloke.” The developers are sharing their private jokes with the players, leaving their signatures in out-of-reach places. It’s been that way since the very first easter egg: The people in the game are talking to us, but they make it hard to hear them.
Part 2: You Weren’t Supposed to Be Here

The developers are very present in GTA 3. The game came in hot, suffered hurried changes, and still showed a lot of its arcadey roots. The veil between the game and its inner workings is thinnest here, you can out of bounds and fly the unflyable dodo across nonexistent towns named after team members. Look to La Luna through the eyes of a sniper rifle and pull the trigger to change the size of the moon, since the devs never decided how big it should be. You had to be willing to break the game a little bit to earn your peek behind the curtain, but it wasn’t that hard to do in 2001.

Rockstar anticipated our escape. If you drive up a staircase near a parking lot in Staunton Island, you can hop out and use your car to climb onto a normally inaccessible roof. A precision jump drops you in an unused back alley, where you’ll find a sign that says “You weren’t supposed to be able to get here, you know.” The devs mercifully included a ramp to get us back into the game proper rather than risking a softlock. They knew we’d be snooping around.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/gta-easter-eggs-you-werent-supposed-to-be-here-1794843405533.jpg

Some developers would dummy out this kind of content once it's discovered, but Rockstar maintained it as a running gag, slapping messages in hard-to-find spots throughout the series. In GTA: Vice City, Tommy can clip through a wall near the VCN helipad to enter a room with a simple marvel pedestal, upon which rests a single egg emblazoned “Happy Easter!”

You’ll find no such ovoid in GTA: San Andreas. The closest you’ll come is the Gant Bridge that connects San Fierro with Las Venturas. The visitor center below contains a display serving up fun facts about the bridge. On closer inspection the text is actually information on the structure’s internal game files, like how it’s made up of 16,000 polygons and takes up a “staggering 1.27mb of disc space.” The sign was actually updated by Grove Street Games for the Definitive Edition release. After 17 years, the bridge’s triangle count doubled, the textures increased fourfold, and the disk space increased a whopping 3,000 percent. Good thing storage has stayed so affordable!
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/gta-easter-eggs-none-up-here-1794843478851.jpg

If CJ can tear himself away from the field trip exhibits and land himself on top of the southern suspension tower, he’ll find another secret scolding among the orange steel rivets: “There are no Easter Eggs up here. Go away.” Clearly anticipating you’d be crushed by the disappointment of your futile search, Rockstar eases the pain with a handy parachute to get you back on your feet.

Grand Theft Auto 4 does the bit, too. And cleverly, though nothing mind-blowing for the most part. A museum placard giving out about how hard the dinosaur skeletons were to sculpt, or a warning inside of the Statue of Happiness, through a door in the base reached only by air. “No hidden content,” reads an engraving by a collision-free closed door. Walk through the illusory wall, however and you’ll encounter something far more visceral than anything that’s come before.

Inside you’ll find a ladder vanishing upwards into the body of the rusted copper colossus. Reach the top and you’ll find a scaffold standing just below a huge and hideous heart. Suspended painfully from chains, its maddening beat thunders inside the internal steel chamber and it cannot die. You’re not going to fit this thing in a bunny’s basket.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/gta-easter-eggs-statue-1794843448313.jpg

It’s a darker, more unsettling easter egg than any that’s come before, even if it’s apparently just a jab at Hillary Clinton, who had gone after Rockstar hard as a senator during the San Andreas Hot Coffee scandal. The Heart of Liberty City is the stuff that creepypastas are made of, legends spread in schoolyards and over IRC. The series had outgrown this style of secret by the time of GTA 5. The mysterious content within its sprawling map goes far beyond the scope of easter eggs, with a nearly cultish following all its own devoted to hunting phantom jetpacks.

Simple secrets like these can be more satisfying than the grand ones. There are no forum flamewars, no rumors to chase for decades, the eggs simply exist to be found in a satisfying fashion. The kind of clean resolution that’s usually reserved for the movies.
Part 3: The Opposition

There are generally two kinds of easter eggs. We’ve already covered the first, the ones aimed inward where developers poke fun at themselves and the players. Rockstar’s other specialty points outward: hidden homages to media outside their own domain.

In GTA, this overwhelmingly manifests as movie and TV references, but for a few years the developers also took aim at some of their fellow video games, and they were surprisingly nasty about it. There’s a sense of decorum within the game industry, you might poke fun at your rivals but never call them out by name. But Rockstar, never one to follow the rules, seemed personally offended by the existence of competition.

news.summary: Ahead of the GTA 6 release this week, publisher Take-Two Interactive and 2K Sports have announced an NBA 2K27

content.v: Ahead of the GTA 6 release this week, publisher Take-Two Interactive and 2K Sports have announced an NBA 2K27 crossover with the game. Starting November 27, Vice City will take over the digital basketball courts, and a special-edition NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition will also be released to promote GTA 6.

The $80 digital-only NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition features Miami Heat player Bam Adebayo on the cover, and for that GTA 6 touch, the art also includes the signature Vice City neon glow. This is something of a first for Take-Two Interactive--and possibly, the rest of the industry--as releasing a special edition of a game that promotes another game isn't something that we've seen before. This version also includes bonus Vice City-themed content and several benefits for GTA+ subscribers.

For Season 3 of NBA 2K27's live-service league, Vice City-themed content and rewards across The City social hub and MyTeam mode will be available to unlock. This three-week promotion will include bonuses and access for GTA+ Members, and Take-Two says players can expect themed apparel, including Vice City and Los Santos jerseys, Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell Employee Outfits, and more.

Vice City-themed limited-time events will run throughout the season, with players competing in Conquer Leonida and Vice Run. MyTeam will also feature Vice City-themed cards, a powerful new Premier Exchange card, and limited-time modes.

The new gear will cost you some bucks, as the Season 3 Pro Pass--which offers access to the premium track with Vice City rewards like the Burger Shot gear, Cluckin' Bell outfit, Cactus Jack jersey, and Macca the Gator--will cost $10. The Hall of Fame Pass, which includes everything from the Pro Pass, 10 instant Level Skips, an extra 15% XP booster, and 15,000 VC, is priced at $20, and to get all the GTA-themed cosmetics, you have to grind through the 40-level season track. If you purchase the Vice City edition, the Season 3 Pro Pass is bundled with your copy.

GTA+ members on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can also play the standard edition of NBA 2K27 for free from November 27 to January 15, 2027. If they like what they see, they'll get 20% off the game if they choose to purchase. GTA 6 preorders also include a one-month trial of GTA+.

Finally, GTA+ members can also download a Vice City bonus content pack featuring a Vice City-styled blue boat hat and oversized T-shirt, 30 skill boosts for five games, and 15 Gatorade boosts for five games.

GTA 6 marketing has been heating up as the game gets closer to launch, and this isn't the only basketball promotion on the table. For one night only, the NBA's Miami Heat will wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys when they host the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18, and the match will take place on a court inspired by Vice City.

news.title: Xbox 为未定义游戏会话提供医生说明，绝对与 GTA 6 无关
news.summary: Xbox has kicked off its marketing for the game it’s not allowed to mention in its marketing. Like the weird al

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/10/ultimate-edition-vice-city-style-03-1794326189563.jpg

Xbox has kicked off its marketing for the game it’s not allowed to mention in its marketing. Like the weird alligator-shaped Xbox recently announced , Microsoft is doing its best to get Xbox players excited about GTA 6 without saying the game’s name.

“Are you suffering from Vitamin G deficiency?” the new marketing blast asked. “Dr. XBOX has you covered.” I don’t know much about supplements, but there’s a real lack of vitamin G, T, and A over there.
For some reason, Dr. Xbox is DJ Khalid, and he wants to get you ready for “the biggest week in gaming.” What makes it the biggest week? No one knows.

The website lets you put your name in and get a personalized doctor’s note to play games this week on your Xbox. Obviously DJ Khalid isn’t a medical professional, and there’s no gamer vitamin, so it probably won’t work on your boss, unfortunately.

“As their physician, mentor, and professional motivator, I am prescribing the patient take some time off to enjoy the biggest week in gaming,” the letter read after I put my details in. “I advise they avoid all meetings, highly stressful jobs, and unnecessary negativity.
“Symptoms may include: twitchy thumbs, controller cramps or release-date restlessness.”
There isn’t a single mention of what makes this the biggest week in gaming. That’s likely because Sony has an exclusive marketing deal with Rockstar to promote the game coming to PlayStation.
This has led to some pretty embarrassing misses on Xbox’s part. The first version of the GTA 6 TV spot failed to mention the game coming to Xbox consoles at all.

Microsoft did manage to muscle in a little more recently, with the announcement that you can play GTA 6 on the cloud . This means even people who only own an Xbox One can play GTA 6 if they stream it, which gets them access to the game at Xbox Series S graphics settings.

We still don’t know what Xbox Series S graphics settings means, however. Rockstar has said GTA 6 will run at 30fps on all platforms , and PS5 Pro gets some ray tracing upgrades, but there’s no word on what kind of compromises the studio had to make to have the game run on the Xbox Series S. We need a doctor on the case.

news.title: 《最终幻想 14》非常希望《Evercold》成为大家都能回归的资料片，所以如果你离开的时间足够长，它会给你 30 天的免费游戏时间
news.summary: Time to finish up that post-Dawntrail MSQ, folks.

content.v: Final Fantasy 14 is set to make some big changes when the upcoming expansion Evercold releases in February. An overhaul to combat, dailies, and new raid difficulties are set to shake things up and, hopefully, keep people sticking around for longer.

And judging by a recent Letter from the Producer , Naoki Yoshida really wants folks coming back to see what Evercold is all about. So much so that the game's offering 30 free days for long-gone adventurers… or a quick-and-dirty paid skip if you're so inclined.

"Encouraging players to return is no mean feat," Yoshida wrote. "People pause their adventures for all kinds of reasons, including dissatisfaction and loss of interest. Although we continually update the game to address such issues, the fact remains that getting players to resume their journey is a difficult task indeed."

I can only assume that for that reason, the decision's been made to offer up a $9 cash shop item that'll skip you through Endwalker's patch story, as well as all of Dawntrail up until the final story patch. Now Final Fantasy 14 has offered paid story skips in the past—it still does—but this is the first time it's explicitly offered one for the current expansion. Usually the skips'll stop dead before the current expansion, meaning you still need to play through the newest story.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2KioQHyeXgGDWhVoH2LzJB-1920-80.png

It's a pretty niche paid skip, too. You'll need to have at least completed Endwalker's main story and have a level 90 job on your chosen character, and even then you'll still have to level up to 100 in your own time in order to tackle the final patch quest of Dawntrail. But worry not, if you haven't played the game in six months, you'll be able to snap up 30 days of free game time until January 14. Plenty of time to get a job to max level and prepare for Evercold.

I'm mostly surprised by the introduction of this paid item because Yoshida has long been rather protective of the game's story. Something he admits in this very same letter: "I strongly believe that FF14 is a story-driven MMORPG," he wrote. "On top of that, skipping it all means you likely won't be familiar with the battle system and therefore will become a burden for other players in multiplayer content."

I do find it a little funny that Yoshida is worried that story skippers will weigh others down in dungeons and the like—I've played many a level 100 dungeon with folks who have clearly played enough to understand how to play yet still can't press their buttons properly.

But anyway, Yoshida does admit that there is a lot of story to get through. "The Hydaelyn and Zodiark saga alone encompasses five expansions' worth of content," he wrote. "And with Dawntrail marking the start of the second saga, plus the coming addition of Evercold, the story continues to unfold into something even larger."

It really does feel like Square Enix wants Evercold to mark a big resurgence for the game, one I really do hope pays off for the developer. I've been playing off-and-on since A Realm Reborn and have seen just about every evolution the game has taken, and also the ways it has stagnated over time. Its confidence in trying to draw people back has me excited for the changes that are coming.

news.title: 在 Xbox 开发工作室附近开枪射杀在押嫌疑人
news.summary: A drive-by shooting in Southern California ended with no injuries and an arrest after the gunman reportedly op

content.v: A drive-by shooting in Southern California ended with no injuries and an arrest after the gunman reportedly opened fire near a business and office campus that houses Xbox subsidiary InXile Entertainment.

According to Aftermath and local affiliate KTLA5 , the shooting occurred on November 11 at an office building on the former Marine Corps Air Station in Tustin, California. The police department posted on Facebook that, after uncovering "multiple shell casings in the area," local detectives worked "around the clock" to locate the suspect.
Sergeant Christopher Peterson told Aftermath on November 13 that although the investigation is still ongoing, an unnamed suspect had been apprehended "less than 48 hours" after the shooting.

"Officers got there [on November 11]," Sergeant Peterson said. "They responded to a report of a drive-by shooting there. Located multiple shell casings. Nobody was hurt. Processed the crime scene, and then sometime [Friday] morning, a little before 11 [AM], they took a suspect into custody. And the investigation is still kind of ongoing as to where and why."
An InXile Entertainment spokesperson corroborated the incident with Aftermath, expressing relief about the situation.
"We're relieved that no one was hurt at our inXile office,” the spokesperson said. "Our focus is on supporting our team, and we are working closely with law enforcement as they investigate."

Founded in 2002, InXile Entertainment has been under the Xbox Game Studios umbrella since 2018. Since its founding, the studio has developed several games, from the 2004 ARPG The Bard's Tale to the 2011 action-adventure Hunted: The Demon's Forge to the 2014 post-apocalyptic RPG Wasteland 2 . Currently, the team is working on Clockwork Revolution , a steampunk ARPG not too dissimilar from immersive sims like BioShock and Dishonored. It has no release date right now, but InXile Entertainment is targeting a 2027 window for PC and Xbox Series X|S.
